description: This source file defines the onboarding UI and controller for the OpenClaw app on macOS. It includes classes, views, enums, and state management related to onboarding flow, remote connectivity, permissions, and UI interactions.

classes.name: OnboardingController
classes.description: Manages the onboarding window, showing, closing, and restarting onboarding UI.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the onboarding window or activates existing window, considering Nix mode and system state.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the onboarding window if open.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Reinitializes the onboarding UI by closing and showing it again.
